purpose: Experiment E-FND-0057 in the foundations arena: the distinguishability readout is pinned in two honest parts: the measured necessary condition (24-cell relabeling invariance, which Fisher-Rao passes at machine precision and any direction-weighted ad-hoc measure fails) plus Chentsov uniqueness under the full Markov-embedding class (cited, not re-proven), so the fragile hand-weighted readouts are killed by measurement and Fisher-Rao is singled out by the theorem.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
